Title: Cyréna Site — Shared Architecture
Summary: Authoritative reference for the Cyréna static website shared architecture: header, footer, navigation, CSS design system, and JavaScript behavior.
Content:
## Overview

The Cyréna static website uses a shared layout and design system across all pages. This reference covers the reusable header, footer, navigation, CSS custom properties, and lightweight JavaScript behavior.

## Shared HTML Structure

### Header (`<header class="site-header">`)
- Sticky header with `backdrop-filter: blur(12px)` and semi-transparent white background.
- Contains `.logo` (text link to `index.html`), `.main-nav` (desktop links), and `.nav-toggle` (mobile hamburger).
- Desktop nav links: Quick Reference, Offline Models, Cloud Models, Tips, About.
- On `about.html`, the About link has `aria-current="page"`.
- On `privacy-policy.html`, the Privacy Policy link has `aria-current="page"`.
- Skip link (`<a href="#main-content" class="skip-link">`) is the first focusable element on every page.

### Footer (`<footer class="site-footer">`)
- Dark background (`--color-footer-bg: #0f172a`).
- Contains `.footer-brand` ("Cyréna"), `.footer-copy` (copyright year via `#year` span), and `.footer-nav` (same links as header plus Privacy Policy).
- On `about.html`, the About link has `aria-current="page"`.
- On `privacy-policy.html`, the Privacy Policy link has `aria-current="page"`.

## CSS Design System

### Custom Properties (`:root`)
- `--color-bg`: `#ffffff`
- `--color-surface`: `#f8f9fa`
- `--color-surface-alt`: `#eef1f4`
- `--color-text`: `#1a1a2e`
- `--color-text-secondary`: `#5a5a6e`
- `--color-accent`: `#2563eb`
- `--color-accent-hover`: `#1d4ed8`
- `--color-accent-light`: `#eff6ff`
- `--color-border`: `#e2e8f0`
- `--color-footer-bg`: `#0f172a`
- `--color-footer-text`: `#94a3b8`
- `--color-tag-offline-bg`: `#dcfce7`, `--color-tag-offline-text`: `#166534`
- `--color-tag-cloud-bg`: `#dbeafe`, `--color-tag-cloud-text`: `#1e40af`
- `--color-badge-bg`: `#fef08a`, `--color-badge-text`: `#854d0e`
- `--font-body`: system-ui stack
- `--radius-sm/md/lg`: `0.5rem / 0.75rem / 1rem`
- `--shadow-sm/md/lg`: layered soft shadows
- `--transition-fast/base`: `150ms / 250ms ease`

### Layout
- `.container`: `max-width: 1200px`, fluid padding via `clamp(1rem, 4vw, 2rem)`.

### Responsive Breakpoints
- `640px`: 2-column grids.
- `768px`: desktop nav visible, hamburger hidden.
- `1024px`: 3-column grids.

### Components
- `.btn`: shared button base with `.btn-primary` (accent fill) and `.btn-secondary` (outline).
- `.tag-offline` / `.tag-cloud`: pill tags with distinct colors.
- `.badge`: yellow highlight badge for featured cards.
- `.review-card`: white/surface card with hover lift (`translateY(-3px)` + `box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg)`).
- `.review-featured`: left accent border (`border-left: 4px solid var(--color-accent)`).

### Mobile Navigation
- `.main-nav` is `display: none` by default.
- `.main-nav.is-open` becomes `display: block` as an absolute dropdown below the header.
- `.nav-toggle` hamburger animates to an X when `aria-expanded="true"`.

## JavaScript Behavior (`js/main.js`)

- **Footer year**: sets `#year` to `new Date().getFullYear()`.
- **Mobile toggle**: click on `.nav-toggle` toggles `aria-expanded` and `.is-open` on `.main-nav`.
- **Auto-close**: clicking any `.nav-list a` closes the mobile menu if open.

## Accessibility
- Semantic landmarks: `<header>`, `<nav>`, `<main>`, `<section>`, `<footer>`.
- `aria-label` on navs.
- `aria-expanded` on hamburger toggle.
- `aria-current="page"` on active nav links.
- `focus-visible` outline using accent color.
- `prefers-reduced-motion` disables smooth scroll and transitions.

## Asset References
- `css/styles.css` — external stylesheet (shared across all pages).
- `js/main.js` — external script (shared across all pages).
